items.exemplar:
A. Bush declared a 'War on Terror' and invaded Afghanistan (2001) to destroy al-Qaeda and topple the Taliban regime sheltering it.

B. Congress passed the USA Patriot Act, expanding surveillance and detention powers, and created the Department of Homeland Security.

C. Obama moved in new directions: the Affordable Care Act (2010) expanded health coverage, and he ordered the raid that killed Osama bin Laden (2011) while winding down the Iraq War.
parts: A. Briefly explain ONE government response to the 9/11 attacks.
B. Briefly explain a SECOND government response to 9/11.
C. Briefly explain ONE way Barack Obama moved the country in a new direction.
items.stimulus: Historian Julian Zelizer argues that 9/11 'fundamentally reoriented American government' — expanding executive power, launching two wars, and making counterterrorism the organizing principle of national security.
